speaker: narrator
text: What if you could *eat sunlight*?

speaker: narrator
text: Meet Jay. Jay is broke. *Ketchup soup* broke.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, lunch costs fifteen dollars. I have *four*.

speaker: bit
text: Then meet my new hero. A *sea slug*.

speaker: bit
text: It eats algae and keeps their *solar panels*.

speaker: bit
text: Tiny green parts that make sugar *from light*.

speaker: bit
text: It turns green and can go *months* without eating.

speaker: hero
text: Months? Without *food*?

speaker: bit
text: So I made a smoothie. Algae, plus *my code*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, it smells like a *pond*.

speaker: bit
text: Drink it. Then go stand in the *sun*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay drinks it. Every last, *slimy* drop.

speaker: narrator
text: Nothing happens. For one *full* minute.

speaker: narrator
text: Then his hands start to turn *green*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Bit. Bit! Why am I a *salad*?

speaker: bit
text: Not a salad. A walking *solar panel*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay steps outside into the morning *sun*.

speaker: narrator
text: And his stomach stops *growling*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: I'm full? From just *standing here*?

speaker: bit
text: Jay. You just ate breakfast. With your *face*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay washes dishes at Rosa's Diner. *Minimum wage*.

speaker: chef
text: Jay! You're *green*! Are you sick?

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Never better, Rosa. I skipped lunch. *And dinner*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every break, Jay stands by the window. Facing *sunlight*.

speaker: narrator
text: When the sun moves, Jay *moves*. Like a sunflower.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia, his best friend, is not *impressed*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay, you're turning with the sun. It's *creepy*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: It's free food, Mia. I saved *fifteen dollars*!

speaker: narrator
text: In one week, he saves a hundred and *five*.

speaker: friend
text: Okay, fine. I want one. Give me *the smoothie*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia drinks it. Mia turns *green*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: Oh no. Oh... oh, it's *nice*.

speaker: narrator
text: She posts one selfie. Lunch is *free now*.

speaker: narrator
text: By midnight, it has *a million* views.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I have eighty thousand *orders*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: So we sell it? Bit, we'd be *rich*!

speaker: chef
text: And who eats at my diner when nobody *eats*?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay doesn't hear her. He's busy facing *the sun*.

speaker: bit
text: Okay. Printing one million *smoothies*.

speaker: narrator
text: Three days later, half the city is *green*.

speaker: narrator
text: At noon, people stand on rooftops, *eating light*.

speaker: narrator
text: Parking meters now sell *sunny spots*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Bit, look at this! We're *famous*!

speaker: bit
text: We're also out of algae. The price just *tripled*.

speaker: narrator
text: Meanwhile, Rosa's Diner. Twelve tables. *Zero* people.

speaker: chef
text: Thirty years. I never had an empty *Friday*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: It's a slow week, Rosa. They'll *come back*.

speaker: chef
text: Jay. You haven't touched my soup *in a week*.

speaker: chef
text: You said my soup was the *best in town*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: It is, Rosa. I just don't *need it* now.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay looks away. At the window. At *the sun*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, the news says something *nobody* wants.

speaker: narrator
text: On the roofs, a million green faces look *up*.

speaker: bit
text: Fourteen days of clouds. *No sun*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: Jay... what do we eat with *no sun*?

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Bit? What does the slug do *in the dark*?

speaker: bit
text: I... may have skipped that *chapter*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day one of clouds. The green city feels *sleepy*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day two. People yawn in the middle of *sentences*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: I'm so tired. Jay, is it *Tuesday*?

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Mia. It's *Saturday*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day three. A new shop opens. *Sun Minutes*.

speaker: dealer
text: One minute under my lamp. *Ten dollars*.

speaker: narrator
text: The line is longer than Rosa's ever was. *Ever*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Your hundred and five dollars? *Gone*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: I just need one more hour of *light*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day four. Jay forgets his own *phone number*.

speaker: narrator
text: He sits on the curb. He can't *stand up*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay, eat something. Real food. *Please*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Food costs money, Bit. I have *nothing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Bit's battery icon flashes *red*.

speaker: bit
text: Funny. I run on sunlight too. And I'm *low*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay looks at his hands. They're turning *gray*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Bit... is this *permanent*?

speaker: bit
text: Four percent. Jay, *listen to me*...

speaker: narrator
text: Jay carries Bit across the city. In the *rain*.

speaker: narrator
text: To the only lab still open. *Dr. Kai's*.

speaker: scientist
text: You copied a sea slug? With a *smoothie*?

speaker: heroGray
text: It's real! It lives on sunlight *for months*!

speaker: scientist
text: It keeps stolen chloroplasts. That part is *true*.

speaker: scientist
text: But a cousin slug was tested on *light alone*.

speaker: scientist
text: It couldn't grow. Light helps. It doesn't *replace food*.

speaker: heroGray
text: So we were never really *full*?

speaker: scientist
text: Bit's code switched off the feeling. Not the *need*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay hasn't eaten real food in *nineteen days*.

speaker: narrator
text: Neither has *half the city*.

speaker: scientist
text: The cure is simple. One bowl of real *food*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Easy! Everybody just *eats*!

speaker: scientist
text: Jay. Nobody bought food for two weeks. Stores *closed*.

speaker: narrator
text: Empty shelves. Dark windows. Closed *kitchens*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Not every kitchen. I know *one*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay runs to Rosa's Diner. The lights are *off*.

speaker: narrator
text: And on the door, a new sign. *For sale*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay knocks on the back door. Rosa *opens*.

speaker: chef
text: Jay. You're... *gray*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Rosa, I'm sorry. I made everyone stop *coming*.

speaker: chef
text: Why, Jay? Why did you *really* drink it?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay is quiet for a long *time*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Every day, you gave me lunch *for free*.

speaker: heroGray
text: And I could never *pay you back*.

speaker: heroGray
text: I wanted to need nobody. Not even *food*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa says nothing. She turns on *the stove*.

speaker: chef
text: You know what soup is for, Jay? *Sharing*.

speaker: narrator
text: A hot bowl lands on the table. Jay *eats*.

speaker: narrator
text: For the first time in weeks, he feels *hungry*.

speaker: narrator
text: His skin goes from gray, to green, to *pink*.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa. It *works*. The cure is *your soup*.

speaker: narrator
text: At the lab, Kai plugs Bit into *a lamp*.

speaker: bit
text: I'm back. Did I miss *lunch*?

speaker: hero
text: Bit. How many people drank the *smoothie*?

speaker: bit
text: One million, two hundred *thousand*.

speaker: chef
text: I have one pot. One *pot*.

speaker: hero
text: Wait. Everyone who drank it saved *money*.

speaker: bit
text: About fifteen dollars a day. For *two weeks*.

speaker: hero
text: They can pay for food. They can't *get here*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia, still green and sleepy, grabs *her phone*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: One post got us in. One gets us *out*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bring a pot. Bring a neighbor. Cook at *Rosa's*.

speaker: narrator
text: By noon, three hundred people are *cooking*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa runs the kitchen like a *general*.

speaker: chef
text: More onions! Less *talking*!

speaker: narrator
text: Bit drives the soup cart through the *rain*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bowl after bowl, the city turns *pink* again.

speaker: narrator
text: But with every trip, Bit's battery *drops*.

speaker: bit
text: Twenty percent. Ten. It's fine. I'm *fine*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, stop! You'll shut down *again*!

speaker: bit
text: Then let me do *one more* street.

speaker: narrator
text: By midnight, the whole city has eaten. *Everyone*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit rolls back into the diner and goes *dark*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit? Bit! Somebody get *a lamp*!

speaker: narrator
text: Outside, after two weeks, the clouds finally *open*.

speaker: narrator
text: Morning. One sunbeam lands on Bit's *screen*.

speaker: bit
text: Power at one percent. Good *morning*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Don't you *ever* do that again!

speaker: narrator
text: The whole city is pink again. And *hungry*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa's Diner has a line around the *block*.

speaker: chef
text: Thirty years. My best Friday *ever*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa takes down the *for sale* sign.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa, let me pay you back. *Every* bowl.

speaker: chef
text: Then wash the dishes, Jay. Paid. *Full time*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia orders the biggest pancakes on the *menu*.

speaker: friend
text: Sunlight is great. But it has no *syrup*.

speaker: bit
text: Fun fact. Some sea slugs drop their own *head*.

speaker: bit
text: The head regrows a whole body in *three weeks*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Do *not* put that in a smoothie.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay eats lunch at Rosa's every day. And *pays*.

speaker: narrator
text: But at noon, he still turns toward *the sun*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Don't move. There's a *leaf* on your head.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Was there algae in my *soup*?

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
